title: 第2章  拔刀成神
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
离着陈家约莫半里路，有一条蜿蜒小河。
陈时安缓步走进河边的小树林，那里早早等着一位身材魁梧，满脸横肉的汉子。
“苏晴柔呢？”汉子见到陈时安一人前来，面露疑惑且恼怒的表情。
他是风起城寨城卫营的一名什长，姓赵，名德胜。
赵德胜本是陈时安大哥的手下，大哥一死，他便成了什长。
苏晴柔本是圣武皇朝的官宦小姐，生得肤白貌美，因为父亲落罪，被牵连流放到了荒墟，最后和陈时安的大哥走到了一起。
垂涎苏晴柔美貌的，不仅仅是原主，还有赵德胜。
陈时安大哥在世的时候，将赵德胜当兄弟，时常请他到家里吃饭喝酒，不成想引狼入室。
就在十天前，陈时安的大哥刚咽气，赵德胜就找到了原主，表达了要买苏晴柔母女的想法，并出价十两。
原主正为银子发愁，如此好事找上门，自然不会拒绝，当即一口应承下来，还收了三两银子做定金。
“赵哥，还得麻烦您再等上几天。”陈时安的脸上带着歉意与谄媚。
赵德胜生得五大三粗、孔武有力，虽然不是入品武者，但能当风起城寨城卫营的什长，战斗力肯定不差。
陈时安前世乃是边疆军人，负重行军、山地越野，擒拿格斗、刺杀操、…………，样样精通，但现在，他细胳膊细腿，弱不禁风，连一个苏晴柔都拽不动，白瞎了一身的战斗意识。
打？十成有十一成打不过。
归还定金，取消交易？
也行不通，因为定金早被原主给输了个干净。
故而，他今天还解决不了赵德胜的问题，只想着先将他稳住，争取一些时间。
“还要等？”
赵德胜当即双眉倒竖，“陈时安，说好的十天，你已经收了定金，现在又让我等，你是把我当猴耍么？”
陈时安陪着笑脸，赶紧摆手，“赵哥，风起城寨谁不知道您的大名，即便给一百个胆子，我也不敢耍您呐。”

赵德胜冷哼，“你小子该不会是舍不得苏晴柔，想留着自己用吧？”
陈时安心中发冷，面上却笑容不减，“我大哥尸骨未寒，我虽然混账，但也做不出这等畜生行径。
再说了，我还等着赵哥的银子去赌坊捞本呢。
之所以要赵哥再等几天，咱们这里虽然是荒墟，规矩不多，但人死了也还兴做七，我大哥刚过头七，灵前总得有个女人点香烧纸……………。”
“听你意思，你要把七做完？”赵德胜的脸色阴沉起来，微眯的双目中有寒光闪现。
陈时安连连摆手，“不需要那么久，过了二七就行。
今天已经是二七的第三天，您只要再等四天，我一定将人给您带过来，还保证清清爽爽，水水灵灵。”
看到赵德胜的眉头仍旧紧皱着，他立马加了一句，“赵哥，让您多等上四天，这是我的错，我愿意赔偿，原本说好十两银子，我只要九两，如何？”
闻言，赵德胜的表情稍缓，但仍旧语气不善，“陈时安，看在咱们也算有几分交情的份上，我便再给你四天的时间。
四天之后，你若是不将苏晴柔交给我，可别怪我翻脸无情！”
“多谢赵哥体谅。”陈时安赔笑哈腰，连连道谢。
赵德胜冷哼一声，大踏步走出了树林。
看到赵德胜的背影越行越远，陈时安脸上的笑容渐渐收敛。
原主不是好鸟，赵德胜也不是个东西。
同时，他还有几分怀疑，大哥半年前的受伤，可能不是意外。
大哥一死，赵德胜当了城卫营的什长，如今还要打苏晴柔的主意，成了最大受益者。
如果怀疑正确，赵德胜的嫌疑便很大。
不过，现在不是考虑这个问题的时候。
目前最紧迫的，就是去弄银子。
………………

苏晴柔母女看到陈时安这么快回来，颇有些意外。
以往的时候，陈时安每次出门赌钱，不管输赢，总要捱到天色大黑才回，并且一身酒气。
“小叔，事情办完了么？”苏晴柔小心翼翼地问询。
陈时安点了点头，快步走回自己的房间。
陈甜甜走到苏晴柔的身边，轻哼道：“母亲，他肯定是在赌坊借不到赌本，灰溜溜地回来了。”
苏晴柔拉住女儿，“甜甜，不要瞎说，你有没有发现，你小叔今天有些不一样？”
陈甜甜紧跟了一句，“哪里不一样？就在刚刚，我们差点就被他赶出陈家。
江山易改本性难移，狗永远改不了吃屎…………。”
陈时安回到房间，盘膝坐到了床上。
前世，他有一个习惯，遇到难事的时候，就会静下心来打坐冥想。
每逢大事有静气。
刚一闭上眼，他的脸上陡然露出震惊的表情。
在他闭眼的刹那，赫然发现，脑海之中居然出现了一块石碑。
半人高，半尺厚，青色。
正中央一行篆体大字：吾归故土，拔刀成神！
是它！它居然跟着我穿越过来了。
吾归故土。
难不成，这块石碑原本就属于这方世界？
陈时安的记忆立马被拉回到了前世：
一次边疆巡视，他在一处不知名的遗迹中发现了一块青色石碑，形状模样和脑海中的石碑一模一样，却只有巴掌大小。

碑上也有字，同样是篆体，但却写着：送吾归故土。
陈时安身在军营，训练之余最大的爱好便是看书，唐诗宋词、天文地理，……，所看甚杂。
主打一个：好读书，不求甚解。
闲书杂书看多了，偶尔也能派上用场。
他能将石碑上的篆体字认全，并判断碑文有些年头。
同时，石碑的大小合适，拿在手里就是一个不错的手把件。
于是，他便将小石碑给收了起来。
闲暇之余，就拿出来把玩。
只是，一次部队换防，他将小石碑给遗留在了营地。
没想到，小石碑此际居然出现在了他的脑海中。
尽管石碑变大了，上面的字也变了，但是，在手上把玩了足足三年，他还是一眼便将石碑给认了出来。
……………
我能穿越，难道是因为这块石碑？
拔刀成神，这又是什么意思？
陈时安一肚子的疑问，将注意力集中到了石碑上。
突然，脑海中的石碑微微一颤，其上的字突然发生了变化：
拔刀三十万次，武者入品！
入品武者？陈时安浑身一震。
此方世界，武者的修为境界，有下九品三上境之说。
下九品，由低到高，为一品到九品。

上三境，御风境、离虚境和自在境。
入品武者，即便是最低的一品武者，在凡俗百姓的眼中，也绝对是高高在上的存在。
风起城寨之所以能在荒墟中屹立不倒，就是因为有几位入品武者在支撑。
而且，这几位武者的品级并不高，最高才四品。
武者修炼，财侣法地样样不能缺。
多少人为了出人头地，选择修炼，但最终能入品者，万不足一。
陈时安的大哥，想尽各种办法，吃过万千苦头，辛苦修炼三十多载，却始终徘徊在武者的门槛之外，无法入品。
拔刀三十万次，就能成为入品武者？
陈时安顿时激动起来。
若是能成为入品武者，眼前的困境将迎刃而解。
不管这事真不真，他都得抓住这根救命稻草。
于是，他连忙从床上下来，出了房间，火急火燎地找到苏晴柔，
“嫂嫂，刀呢，大哥的刀在哪里？”
苏晴柔先是一怔，继而面露急色，“小叔，这是怎么了，被人欺负了么？
你千万不要冲动，如今你大哥不在了，若是闯下祸事，可没人再给你出头。”
陈时安面现笑意，“嫂嫂，你安心，我不是要和人拼命，是准备从今天起，开始习刀修炼。”
“你要修炼？”
苏晴柔眨了眨眼睛，一脸难以置信的表情。
先前，丈夫不止一次地想要让陈时安修炼。
但是，陈时安哪里吃得了这个苦，只要丈夫没空盯着，就跑去城寨鬼混。

难不成，丈夫一死，小叔转了性，懂事了？
苏晴柔稍作犹豫，到屋里取出一柄横刀，递到陈时安的手中。
这是风起城寨城卫营的制式刀，直身窄刃，长约两尺半。
半年前，大哥养伤卧床，这柄横刀就丢在角落里，刀鞘和刀柄之上，已经积下一层灰。
陈时安用衣袖三两下擦去灰尘，迫不及待地拔刀出鞘。
只听铮的一声，利刀出鞘，寒光闪烁。
心神一动，念头立马进入到了脑海之中。
只见，神秘石碑上的字又发生了改变：拔刀一次。
登时，陈时安受到莫大的鼓舞，连忙收刀归鞘。
很快又拔了出来，再归鞘，如此循环往复，像一个机器人一般。
苏晴柔呆愣在了原地。
这也叫习刀修炼？
content_en:
About half a mile away from Chen's house, there is a winding river.
Chen Shi'an walked slowly into the woods by the river, where a tall man with a sinewy face was waiting.
"Where's Su Qingrou?" When the man saw Chen Shi'an coming alone, he looked confused and annoyed.
He is a chief of the guard camp of Fengqi City Walled City. His surname is Zhao and his given name is Desheng.
Zhao Desheng was originally a subordinate of elder brother Chen Shi'an. Once his elder brother died, he became a great leader.
Su Qingrou was originally an official from the Shengwu Dynasty. She was born with white skin and beauty. Because her father was convicted, she was implicated and exiled to the ruins. Finally, she got together with Chen Shi'an's eldest brother.
It was not only the original owner who coveted Su Qingrou's beauty, but also Zhao Desheng.
When the eldest brother Chen Shi'an was alive, he regarded Zhao Desheng as a brother and often invited him to his house for dinner and drinks, not wanting to lure wolves into the house.
Just ten days ago, as soon as Chen Shian's eldest brother died, Zhao Desheng found the original owner, expressed his intention to buy Su Qingrou and his daughter, and offered a price of ten taels.
The original owner was worried about money. When such a good thing came to his door, he naturally would not refuse it. He immediately agreed and accepted three taels of silver as a deposit.
"Brother Zhao, I have to trouble you to wait a few more days." Chen Shi'an's face was apologetic and flattering.
Zhao Desheng was born with great strength and strength. Although he was not a top-grade warrior, he could be the commander of the guard camp of Fengqi City, so his fighting ability was definitely not bad.
In his previous life, Chen Shi'an was a frontier soldier. He was proficient in marching with heavy loads, cross-country in the mountains, capturing and fighting, assassination exercises, etc. But now, with his thin arms and legs, he is so weak that he cannot even drag Su Qingrou, and his fighting consciousness has been lost.
beat? 11% out of 10 can't be beaten.
Return the deposit and cancel the transaction?
It doesn't work, because the original owner has already lost all the deposit.
Therefore, he could not solve Zhao Desheng's problem today, so he just wanted to stabilize him first and buy some time.
"Still waiting?"
Zhao Desheng immediately raised his eyebrows and said, "Chen Shi'an, you have already collected the deposit for ten days as promised, and now you are asking me to wait. Are you treating me like a monkey?"
Chen Shi'an smiled and waved his hand quickly, "Brother Zhao, who in Fengqi City doesn't know your name? Even if I had a hundred courages, I wouldn't dare to play tricks on you."
Zhao Desheng snorted coldly, "Is it possible that you are reluctant to part with Su Qingrou and want to keep it for yourself?"
Chen Shi'an felt cold in his heart, but the smile on his face remained unchanged, "My eldest brother's body is still cold. Although I am a bastard, I can't do such an animal behavior.
Besides, I'm still waiting for Brother Zhao's money to go to the gambling house to make money.
The reason why Brother Zhao is asked to wait for a few more days is that although our place is a deserted place with not many rules, people still enjoy doing seven after death. My eldest brother has just passed his seventh day, and there must be a woman lighting incense and burning paper before his death... "
"What do you mean, do you want to finish Qi?" Zhao Desheng's face turned gloomy, and a cold light flashed in his slightly narrowed eyes.
Chen Shi'an waved his hands repeatedly, "It doesn't take that long, just after February 7th.
Today is already the third day of February 7th. You only need to wait for four more days, and I will definitely bring him over to you. I will also ensure that you are refreshed and the water is flowing. "
Seeing that Zhao Desheng's brows were still frowning, he immediately added, "Brother Zhao, it's my fault for making you wait four more days. I'm willing to compensate. We originally agreed on ten taels of silver, but I only need nine taels. How about that?"
Hearing this, Zhao Desheng's expression softened slightly, but his tone was still harsh, "Chen Shi'an, since we have some friendship, I will give you four more days.
After four days, if you don't hand Su Qingrou over to me, don't blame me for being ruthless! "
"Thank you for your understanding, Brother Zhao." Chen Shi'an smiled and bowed, thanking him repeatedly.
Zhao Desheng snorted coldly and strode out of the woods.
Seeing Zhao Desheng's back walking further and further away, the smile on Chen Shi'an's face gradually faded.
The original owner was not a good bird, and neither was Zhao Desheng.
At the same time, he still has some doubts, brotherThe injury half a year ago might not have been an accident.
After the death of his eldest brother, Zhao Desheng became the chief of the city guard camp. Now he wants to scheme against Su Qingrou, becoming the biggest beneficiary.
If the suspicion is correct, Zhao Desheng's suspicion will be high.
However, now is not the time to consider this issue.
The most urgent thing at the moment is to get money.
………………
Su Qingrou and her daughter were quite surprised to see Chen Shi'an coming back so soon.
In the past, every time Chen Shian went out to gamble, no matter whether he won or lost, he would always wait until dark before returning, smelling of alcohol.
"Uncle, are things done?" Su Qingrou asked cautiously.
Chen Shi'an nodded and walked quickly back to his room.
Chen Tiantian walked to Su Qingrou and hummed: "Mom, he must have been unable to borrow money from the gambling house and came back in despair."
Su Qingrou grabbed her daughter and said, "Tiantian, don't talk nonsense. Have you noticed that your brother-in-law is a little different today?"
Chen Tiantian followed closely, "What's different? Just now, we were almost kicked out of the Chen family by him.
A country can change its nature easily, but a dog can never change its habit of eating shit... "
Chen Shi'an returned to the room and sat cross-legged on the bed.
In his previous life, he had a habit of calming down and meditating when he encountered difficulties.
Be calm in every big event.
As soon as he closed his eyes, a shocked expression suddenly appeared on his face.
The moment he closed his eyes, he suddenly discovered that a stone tablet actually appeared in his mind.
Half a man tall, half a foot thick, cyan.
In the center is a line of large seal characters: I return to my homeland, draw my sword and become a god!
That's it! It actually followed me through time.
I return to my homeland.
Is it possible that this stone tablet originally belonged to this world?
Chen Shian's memory was immediately pulled back to his previous life:
During a border inspection, he discovered a blue stone tablet in an unknown ruins. The shape and appearance were exactly the same as the stone tablet in his mind, but it was only the size of a palm.
There are also words on the stele, also in seal script, but it says: Send me back to my homeland.
Chen Shi'an was in the military camp. His biggest hobby after training was reading books, including Tang poetry and Song poetry, astronomy and geography, etc. He read a lot of things.
The main theme is: good at reading, and don’t ask for deep explanations.
I have read a lot of idle books and miscellaneous books, and they can come in handy occasionally.
He was able to recognize all the seal characters on the stone tablet and judged the age of the inscription.
At the same time, the size of the stele is suitable, and it is a good handle piece in your hand.
So, he put away the small stone tablet.
In my spare time, I took it out and played with it.
However, when the troops changed defense, he left the small stone tablet behind in the camp.
Unexpectedly, the small stone tablet actually appeared in his mind at this moment.
Although the stone tablet had grown larger and the words on it had changed, he could still recognize the stone tablet at a glance after playing with it for three years.
……………
Is it because of this stone tablet that I can travel through time?
What does it mean to draw a sword and become a god?
Chen Shi'an was full of questions and focused his attention on the stone tablet.
Suddenly, the stone tablet in my mind trembled slightly, and the words on it suddenly changed:
After drawing the sword 300,000 times, the warrior becomes a top grade warrior!
A top-grade warrior? Chen Shi'an was shocked.
In this world, the cultivation realm of warriors is said to be the lower ninth level and the third upper level.
The lower nine grades, from low to high, are the first grade to the ninth grade.
The three upper realms are the wind-controlling realm, the emptiness-free realm, and the free-spirited realm.
A first-grade warrior, even the lowest first-grade warrior, is definitely a superior being in the eyes of ordinary people.
The reason why Fengqi Walled City can stand firm in the ruins is because there are several high-level warriors supporting it.
Moreover, the grades of these warriors are not high, the highest is only fourth grade.
When a warrior practices, the wealthy couple, Dharma, and Dharma are indispensable.
How many people choose to practice in order to get ahead, but in the end, only one can reach the top level.
Chen Shian’s eldest brother tried every means to eat more than 10,000 yuanAfter thousands of hardships and hard training for more than thirty years, he still lingers outside the threshold of a warrior and cannot enter the first level.
Can you become a top-grade warrior by drawing your sword 300,000 times?
Chen Shi'an suddenly became excited.
If you can become a top-grade warrior, the current dilemma will be easily solved.
Regardless of whether this was true or not, he had to grasp at this life-saving straw.
So, he quickly got off the bed, left the room, and found Su Qingrou in a hurry.
"Sister-in-law, where is the knife? Where is brother's knife?"
Su Qingrou was startled for a moment, then looked anxious, "Uncle, what's going on? Are you being bullied?
You must not be impulsive. Now that your eldest brother is gone, if you cause trouble, no one will stand up for you. "
Chen Shi'an smiled and said, "Sister-in-law, don't worry, I'm not trying to fight anyone, but I'm planning to start practicing swordsmanship from today on."
"You want to practice?"
Su Qingrou blinked her eyes with an expression of disbelief.
Previously, her husband wanted to let Chen Shian practice more than once.
However, Chen Shi'an couldn't bear the hardship. As long as her husband didn't have time to stare, he would go to the walled city and fool around.
Is it possible that after her husband died, my brother-in-law changed his gender and became sensible?
Su Qingrou hesitated for a moment, then went into the room and took out a horizontal knife and handed it to Chen Shi'an's hand.
This is the standard sword of Fengqi City Walled City Guard Camp. It has a straight body and a narrow blade, about two and a half feet long.
Half a year ago, my eldest brother was recovering from an injury and was in bed. This horizontal knife was thrown in the corner. There was a layer of dust on the scabbard and handle.
Chen Shi'an wiped off the dust with his sleeves and couldn't wait to draw the sword out of its sheath.
Just a clang sound was heard, the sharp knife was unsheathed, and the cold light flashed.
As soon as my mind moved, the idea immediately entered my mind.
I saw that the words on the mysterious stone tablet changed again: draw the sword once.
Immediately, Chen Shian was greatly encouraged and quickly sheathed his sword.
He quickly pulled it out and put it back into its sheath, repeating the cycle like a robot.
Su Qingrou froze on the spot.
Is this also called sword practice?
